text: Completed source composers and provenance. Added DatasetProvenance as an optional DatasetMetadata value that flows into FmriSeries. Added JVM FmriDataset.openLna with mandatory SamplingFrame, external run derivation from run-<entity>, exact-or-unique internal RunLabel selection, typed lookup folding, selection-aware vs whole-run-fallback LNA provenance, codec family and external basis identity. Removed silent run-zero defaults from LnaDataset backend/materialization methods. Added shared CanonicalBoldSampling refinement and SamplingPrecisionPolicy, plus JVM FmriDataset.openZarr with JvmFileStore/NeuroArchive validation, ReadLimits/options, checked response backend, and NeuroArchive provenance. Tests cover seconds/milliseconds, zero/nonzero/negative origins, short TR, overflow, explicit timing, invalid precision, ambiguous/missing LNA internal runs, shared external basis, provenance propagation, source-blind reads, read limits, and store error folding. Gates passed: datasetJVM 67, datasetJS 41, datasetZarrJVM 15, datasetZarrJS 7. Relevant diff check clean.
